title: 舅舅搶麥克風
subject: a ska band hired for a wedding banquet when the groom's uncle grabs the microphone during the toast round
caption: Mandarin ska in the two-tone revival style of Taiwan and Hong Kong ska bands. A choppy offbeat upstroke guitar skank; a trumpet and trombone horn section punching unison riffs; a walking electric bass; fast two-tone drums with rimshots and a driving hi-hat; a bouncy organ doubling the skank. Live and punchy, horns bright and forward, a small banquet-hall room sound. Male tenor, bright and talky, with shouted gang vocals from the horn players on the chorus. 158 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, cheeky, banquet-hall chaos. No reggae one-drop slowdown, no heavy metal guitars, no EDM, no autotune, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - guitar skank and trumpet-trombone riff]

[Verse 1]
喜宴第三道菜 我們剛上台
新郎說來點歡樂的 不要太吵
小號才吹兩下 第七桌站起來
新郎的舅舅 端著紹興走過來

[Pre-Chorus]
他說借一下 一下就好
手已經握住了麥克風

[Chorus]
舅舅搶麥克風 舅舅搶麥克風
他要唱一首 二十年前的歌
我們只好跟上 他自己的調
整個宴會廳 跟著跳

[Verse 2]
他唱錯了歌詞 沒人敢說
新娘的姑姑 在台下打拍子
長號手笑到 吹不出聲
服務生端著魚 也在搖

[Pre-Chorus]
新郎看著我 搖搖頭
可是他嘴角在偷笑

[Chorus - gang vocals]
舅舅搶麥克風 舅舅不還麥克風
他又點一首 說是新娘最愛
我們只好跟上 他又升了調
整個宴會廳 跳到上甜湯

[Outro - horns and skank fade]
散場他塞給我一個紅包
說明年他兒子結婚 你們再來
